description.content:
Interactive in-stream overlay and viewer-engagement platform API for OTT/CTV. Two surfaces: adminApi (broadcaster/admin management of streamers, polls, trivia, ratings, wikis, shop, sponsors, prizes, analytics) and userApi (end-viewer play: register/login, answer polls/trivia/ratings, chat, leaderboard, shop). Converted from the provider-published Postman collection "Inthegame API Docs".
